name: MIREX Melody Extraction Evaluation
description: An MIREX benchmark for evaluating melody extraction systems, typically testing whether the algorithm can identify the predominant melodic pitch contour in polyphonic audio.
evaluation_method: Raw pitch accuracy, voicing recall/false alarm, and overall accuracy using MIREX melody metrics.
notes: Melody extraction is affected by instrumentation, accompaniment density, and annotation conventions. It is a classic MIR benchmark with long-running community usage.
